data.long_meaning: Joshna is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Jnana' meaning knowledge. In Hindu mythology, Joshna is the name of the Goddess of wisdom and knowledge. She is often depicted as holding a book or a lotus, symbols of knowledge and learning. The name Joshna carries the meaning “Goddess of Knowledge” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Joshna usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of knowledge and live with faith, good character and purpose.
